ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity white pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous black region in the center and lower fluke. Lateral lobes display white fields with dense black mottling. Right lobe features a prominent white field with three distinct parallel diagonal black streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex; approximate interior angle of 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serrations across the entire trailing edge. Notable macro-indentation (notch) located on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges exhibit a strong convex curvature. Trailing edges follow a multi-inflection concave path toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white circular clusters (barnacle attachment points) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct parallel black linear marks on the right lobe's white field; multiple fine, unaligned white linear scratches visible on the central black region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular indentation on the inner-right trailing edge and significant jagged serration suggesting historical physical trauma or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique and symmetrical triple-parallel linear pigmentation pattern on the distal white field of the right lobe.
